{{Term/Store|Night Speed Up||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Set Bonus]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page=402-403}}</ref>

==Overview==
Night Speed Up is a [[Set Bonus]] that, between the in-game hours of 9:00pm and 4:00am, mimics the running speed increase provided by a level two [[Speed Up]] [[Added Effect|Effect]]. This increases [[Link]]'s running speed by 20%. It does not increase Link's [[Climbing]] speed or [[Swimming]] speed. Night Speed Up can be stacked with a level one Speed Up effect.

==={{BotW|-}}===
In {{BotW}}, Night Speed Up can be obtained from the following [[Armor Set]]s:

* [[Dark Series]]
* [[Stealth Attire]] (★★)
* [[Tingle's Outfit]]

==={{TotK|-}}===
The Night Speed Up [[Set Bonus]] can be found on the following [[Armor Set]]s in {{TotK}}:

* [[Dark Series]]
* [[Stealth Attire]] (★★)
* [[Tingle's Outfit]]
* [[Yiga Clan Attire]] (★★)
